function: PPO policy jointly sets active-RIS phase shifts and amplification, MEC time slots, IoTD CPU frequency, and UAV speed and direction to maximize sum energy efficiency (p. 6)
system: UAV-mounted active RIS (ULA, M elements, b-bit phases), single-antenna BS and IoTDs, TDMA uplink, 200 m x 200 m area; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, 9)
method: PPO-Clip actor-critic deep reinforcement learning (two hidden layers of 256) with state normalization and learning-rate decay; 9e4 training episodes (p. 8-9)
data_channel: Custom simulated Rician channels (K = 3), path-loss exponent 2.8, IoTD-FRIS and FRIS-BS links, perfect CSI assumed; agent learns by environment interaction (p. 3, 4, 9)
test_conditions: Trained 9e4 episodes in the simulated environment; trained policy then loaded and run for 30 evaluation episodes; network sizes depend on N and M (p. 8-9)
baselines: Learned: DDPG and SAC on the same problem. PPO variants with fixed path, fixed time slots, fixed or random RIS phases, passive RIS; no optimization baseline (p. 9-11)
metrics: Sum energy efficiency (Mbits/J) of IoTDs, sum data rate (Mbps), cumulative reward convergence, per-IoTD offloaded data size and time allocation (p. 10-12)
complexity: Order of training complexity for actor and critic networks, O(Bm x [N/(U/K)] x K x layer-size products); per-step O(sum n_l n_{l+1}); no runtime reported (p. 8)
q1_support: p. 4: "with Rician factor"; Table I (p. 9) sets K1 = K2 = 3 and path-loss exponent 2.8; custom Rician simulator, no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 9: "We load the trained parameters for both the policy and critic networks" and run 30 episodes; p. 6: "with the dimension of A given by" L = 3N + MN + 2, so network size depends on N and M; no unseen N, M, channel, or site is tested.
q3_support: p. 11: "and 6.7% improvement over PPO-RATDFRO-FPS" (fixed reflection matrix, p. 9) is the non-learned comparison; p. 11: "PPO-RATDFRO also surpasses SAC-RATDFRO and DDPG-RATDFRO by 11.2% and 56.5%" is the comparison with standard DRL on sum EE.
q4_support: p. 8: "The training complexity for the actor network is" O(Bm x [N/(U/K)] x K x layer-size products); the critic network has its own order.
q5_support: p. 9: "For detailed simulation parameters, see Table I"; custom simulation, and the paper gives no link, DOI, or release statement for code or data, and uses no public dataset.
notes: Included. Area 6 by the specificity order because the RIS is carried by a UAV and the PPO learns RIS phases and amplification (beams, power) jointly with the UAV trajectory on an aerial link (p. 6); area 3 (RIS configuration) also fits, so the reviewer may confirm. The above_phy check passes because the learned action holds the RIS reflection matrix (p. 6) together with trajectory, MEC time slots, and CPU frequency. The text lists IoTD transmit power as optimized (p. 5, 7) but the action space (p. 6) has no transmit-power term and Table I fixes it at 25 dBm (p. 9). The non-learned comparisons are PPO variants with one module fixed or random, not an optimization algorithm, so q3 rests on the rule that a fixed or random RIS configuration is a valid simple baseline. The complexity given is training complexity only. Page numbers count PDF pages.
